sloka: उद् धुन्वाना रजो घोरम् ताटका राघवौ उभौ ।रजो मेघेन महता मुहूर्तम् सा व्यमोहयत् ॥१-२६-१५॥
transliteration: ud dhunvānā rajo ghoram tāṭakā rāghavau ubhau ।rajo meghena mahatā muhūrtam sā vyamohayat ॥1-26-15॥

translations.english: Tataka raising a cloud of frightening dust left the descendants of Raghu bewildered quite for a moment.
